newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse closes 0.08 percent higher.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse closes 0.08 percent higher.

text.p: The Tunis stock exchange on Friday closed up 0.08 percent despite lower trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 481.72 points, up from 481.32 on Thursday.
Most of the trade was on Societe Tunisienne de Banque with the exchange of 26,510 shares at the unchanged price of 15.51 dinars.
UBCI bank gained 0.66 dinar to 47 dinars.
Insurance firm ASTREE was up 0.48 dinar to 26 dinars.
Retail stores Monoprix rose 0.32 dinar to 34.82. Milk firm Tunisie Lait advanced 0.28 dinar to 24.46 dinars.
Household firm Ateliers Mecaniques du Sahel was down 0.15 dinar to 11.15 dinars. Arab Tunisian Bank edged lower 0.12 dinar to 29.58 dinars.
Total volume was 1.72 million dinars against 3.31 million over the previous session. Turnover on the first market was 1.07 million dinars with 53,826 shares changing hands.
